metadata.question: Did Cincinnati, Ohio have its warmest February in 2018 (surface temperatures at 2 meters) compared to 2010 to 2017?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use ECMWF ERA5-Land Hourly (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY) temperature_2m for Feb 2010–2018 over a 15 km buffer around Cincinnati, OH. If a given year has 0 images, fallback to ECMWF ERA5 Hourly (ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY).
2. Masking strategy: Reanalysis data have no clouds; no masking needed.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error: Check collection size (hrs). If 0 after fallback => C1. Check pixel count (px) from reduceRegion; if 0 => C2. Validate meanK within [200,330] K and finite; else => C3. If calculation succeeds, compare 2018 mean to max of 2010–2017; ties are not “warmest.”
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const city = ee.Geometry.Point([-84.5120, 39.1031]); // Cincinnati, OH
    const region = city.buffer(15000); // 15 km buffer
    const scale = 9000; // ERA5-Land ~9km
    
    const years = ee.List.sequence(2010, 2018);

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Processing
    function yearStats(y) {
      y = ee.Number(y);
      const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(y, 2, 1);
      const end = ee.Date.fromYMD(y, 3, 1);
      const colLand = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .select('temperature_2m');
      const szLand = colLand.size();
      const colEra5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .select('temperature_2m');
      const colUse = ee.ImageCollection(ee.Algorithms.If(szLand.eq(0), colEra5, colLand));
      const used = ee.String(ee.Algorithms.If(szLand.eq(0), 'ERA5', 'ERA5_LAND'));
      const hrs = colUse.size();

      const imgMean = ee.Image(colUse.mean());
      const meanK = ee.Number(
        imgMean.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
          geometry: region,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('temperature_2m')
      );
      const px = ee.Number(
        imgMean.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: region,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('temperature_2m')
      );
      return ee.Feature(null, {
        year: y,
        hrs: hrs,
        meanK: meanK,
        meanC: meanK.subtract(273.15),
        px: px,
        used: used
      });
    }

    const fc = ee.FeatureCollection(years.map(yearStats));
    const fcInfo = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      fc.getInfo(resolve, reject);
    });

    // 3. Validation & Final Answer
    const feats = fcInfo.features || [];
    let c1 = false, c2 = false, c3 = false;
    let maxPrevC = -Infinity, maxPrevYear = null;
    let y2018C = null;

    for (const f of feats) {
      const p = f.properties || {};
      const y = p.year;
      const hrs = p.hrs;
      const meanK = p.meanK;
      const meanC = p.meanC;
      const px = p.px;
      const used = p.used;

      // Print concise yearly stats
      const hrsStr = (hrs === null || hrs === undefined) ? 'null' : hrs;
      const meanCStr = (meanC === null || meanC === undefined) ? 'null' : meanC.toFixed ? meanC.toFixed(2) : meanC;
      const pxStr = (px === null || px === undefined) ? 'null' : px;
      console.log(`${y}: hrs=${hrsStr}, meanC=${meanCStr}, px=${pxStr}, ds=${used}`);

      // C1: Empty collection even after fallback
      if (!Number.isFinite(hrs) || hrs === 0) c1 = true;

      // C2: No valid pixels
      if (!Number.isFinite(px) || px === 0) c2 = true;

      // C3: Invalid calculation
      if (!Number.isFinite(meanK) || meanK < 200 || meanK > 330) c3 = true;

      if (y >= 2010 && y <= 2017 && Number.isFinite(meanC)) {
        if (meanC > maxPrevC) {
          maxPrevC = meanC;
          maxPrevYear = y;
        }
      }
      if (y === 2018) {
        y2018C = meanC;
      }
    }

    if (c1) {
      console.log('One or more years have 0 images after fallback.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (c2) {
      console.log('One or more years have 0 valid pixels.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (c3 || !Number.isFinite(y2018C) || !Number.isFinite(maxPrevC)) {
      console.log('Invalid temperature values detected.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`PrevMax(2010-2017)=${maxPrevC.toFixed(2)}C in ${maxPrevYear}`);
    console.log(`2018 Feb mean=${y2018C.toFixed(2)}C`);

    const isWarmest = y2018C > maxPrevC; // strict greater; ties => not warmest
    console.log(isWarmest ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error:', err);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
